rationale: Every run's worst setup path touches an I/O port at ss 100C max-RC while reg-to-reg has slack, so port-path delay sets T_eff. All three stock-RC runs were infeasible (hold or slew/cap); cap213/orfs runs all passed. Port paths were shortest with timing-driven placement, post-GRT timing repair, cap213 and denser floorplans (util 40 > 30 >> 21-27); non-TD or no-post-GRT-timing runs were clearly worse. Both proposals keep cap213, TD on, routability off, post-GRT timing on, AREA 3, and raise utilisation to shorten pin-to-logic wires: one md5-like (util 38, ABC buffering/sizing, higher margins), one ocs_blitter-like (util 44). Targets 9.7-10.4 ns keep repair pressure without extreme optimism.
